theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (h : Euclid n → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 h U → (∀ y ∈ U, ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0) → ∀ (x : Euclid n) (r R : ℝ), 0 < r → r < R → closedBall x R ⊆ U → ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g → (∀ t : ℝ, r ^ 2 ≤ t → g t = 0) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → ∫ y : Euclid n, fderiv ℝ h (x - s • y) y * g (‖y‖ ^ 2) = 0
